correctness.rationale: The complete Grassmannian Fano equations are computed, not merely their Zariski tangent spaces. On each chart the three linearized minors eliminate D,E,G, and three quadratic coefficients give exactly A^2=AB=B^2=0; all remaining minors reduce to that ideal. The coordinate transition A'= -A, B'=tB-sA matches Omega^1_{P2}(2) over all characteristics. The ruling section splits the square-zero extension and the Euler sequence produces chi_F(n)=6n^2+11n+4. The attached standalone SymPy program was run from its actual path and checks all minors, transition and arithmetic in characteristics 0,2,3,5,7; finite tests are corroboration, not a proof of universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The central invariant is a natural complete Fano scheme of a basic rank-one symmetric determinantal threefold. Its rank-three local multiplicity, twisted rank-two nilradical, non-productness despite trivial affine charts, four global functions and degree-12 Plucker polarization give structural and enumerative information beyond a routine reduced-point classification. This is a concrete nondivisorial case outside the full-scheme coverage of a motivating general toric paper.
